messages:
jen lopez: Heads-up — a handful of private/VPC deliveries are hitting transport token TTLs during overnight handoffs. Some partner sites are reporting unpack failures. :eyes:
matt kim: ack, which artifact window?
jen lopez: 3411110001: batch A (images + installer v1.12.3). Transport svc generated tokens with 6h TTL, but customer staging picked up the bundle ~10h after we created the manifest. failures look like: 
```
ERROR: manifest fetch failed: transport auth expired (token expired)
```
sara v: ouch. Are these the long-route carriers that needed physical transfer?
jen lopez: yeah — offsite courier + manual handoff. We expected <8h but it stretched.
alex r: Can we extend token TTL retroactively? I thought tokens are immutable once minted.
kevin cho: Tokens are short-lived by design. Options: reissue signed prefetch manifest OR create a temporary acceptance endpoint that validates a one-time re-sign. Both need ops approval and a small change to deploybot workflow.
matt kim: If we reissue, we need to ensure artifact integrity checks still pass (sha256). No content change, only signing wrapper. Ops risk: more surface for replay if not one-time.
sara v: Short term: reissue manifests for the affected manifests only, mark them as re-signed with new TTL 24h. Long term: increase TTL for offline handoffs or add a staged "courier-handoff" flow.
jen lopez: proposal: reissue now for batch A only, hold the global rollout for 1h while we confirm courier queues. If courier confirms, we let deploybot proceed. If not, we abort and schedule manual cutover tomorrow morning.
matt kim: +1. Who runs the reissue and where do we log it?
kevin cho: I'll run the reissue. Command I will use: 
```
./tools/manifest-reissue --manifest=manifests/3411110001.yaml --ttl=86400 --reissue-reason="courier-late-handshake"
```
I'll post checksum and signed URL in this thread.
deploy-bot: [info] queued action: reissue-manifest(3411110001) requested by kevin cho
ops-bot: [alert] Note: reissuing will create a new signature blob. Ensure mirror sync picks up new signature before courier fetch. Mirror sync ETA ~5-10m.
kevin cho: reissue complete. Signed manifest: https://mirror.internal/repo/signed/3411110001-manifest.sig sha256: 5f2a9c3b9e7d1f4a9c3e7b2a1f9d0c3b2e4f6a7c8d9e0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9
sara v: mirror synced, courier confirmed pickup ETA 35m.
matt kim: Ok let's put the rollout on a 45m hold window. If courier reports any further delay, we abort and pin images back to staging.
jen lopez: I’ll update release notes snippet for the customer: "Temporary re-sign due to extended handoff — no artifact content change. Contact support if you see integrity errors."
deploy-bot: [action] scheduled: resume-rollout(3411110001) at 3411110046 by ops hold window
kevin cho: leaving a small checklist: 1) monitor mirror logs, 2) confirm courier hash after unpack, 3) drop a followup note to customer.
jen lopez: thanks team. If all good, we'll let deploy-bot continue. If anything fails, we call rollback and pin to staging. :thumbsup:
matt kim: noted. I'll be on standby for rollback steps (cut image tags back to staging + revoke new signature).
kevin cho: courier delivered, hashes match. continuing rollout now.
deploy-bot: [info] rollout resumed for 3411110001 — starting instance promotion. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/3411110001
ops-bot: [success] rollout completed on all target sites for batch A.
jen lopez: closing thread — filing a short postmortem and a followup ticket to add a "courier-handoff" TTL flag to manifest generator.
matt kim: +1 on the feature ticket.
sara v: file number? please include backfill notes for support.
jen lopez: created ticket: INFRA-1284 (manifest TTL: courier-handoff mode).
kevin cho: thanks everyone.
